definitionZh: QSlideItem Vue 组件本质上是一个具有两个附加插槽（左侧和右侧）的 QItem，允许用户将其拖动到一侧以应用特定操作。
sourceDefinition: The QSlideItem Vue component is essentially a QItem with two additional slots (left and right) which allows the user to drag it to one of the sides in order to apply a specific action.
